_comment: IBM Bob `EnforcedHooks` group policy. Policy-enforced hooks run BEFORE user hooks and users cannot override them.
_comment_2: The policy value is a JSON-encoded string, so paste the single-line value of `EnforcedHooks` below into the policy field — not this whole wrapper document.
_comment_3: Generate the value with: otel-hook policy --bob --hook-cmd /opt/otel-hook/bin/otel-hook --raw
_comment_4: Use --escaped instead when nesting the value inside another JSON or plist document.
_comment_5: Point --hook-cmd at the absolute path on the MANAGED machines. A bare `otel-hook` relies on PATH, and Bob ignores a failing hook, so telemetry would go missing silently.
